Tej Pratap Yadav Briefly Detained by Patna Police Amid Bihar Bandh

RJD leader Tej Pratap Yadav was taken into police custody in Patna during a Bihar Bandh called by his party. He was reportedly detained and taken to Naubatpur. The specific reasons for his detention were not detailed in the provided summaries, but it occurred amidst a statewide shutdown.
